PaddleOCR (PP-OCRv6) Pipeline vs. ABBYY FineReader Benchmark

Comprehensive quantitative evaluation, automated lexical validity scoring, and spatial bounding-box alignment analysis across 4154 historical digital archive pages.

AI Executive Verdict Automated Quality Assurance Assessment
Across 4,154 historical pages and 1,600,720 recognized word tokens, the PaddleOCR (PP-OCRv6) pipeline demonstrates exceptional text discovery and multi-column layout arbitration, while exposing real operational trade-offs in GPU compute footprint and marginalia noise. On standard printed typography and complex newspaper broadsheets, Paddle decisively outperforms legacy ABBYY FineReader (84.5% lexical win rate on Annuals, 81.7% lexical win rate on Newspapers). In degraded archival microfilm (Heritage), deep-learning text detection unlocks +298,724 additional words (+37.7% recall expansion), recovering faded ink, stamps, and handwritten margins where ABBYY binarization failed entirely. However, this aggressive sensitivity requires downstream dictionary validation to suppress marginal noise, and multi-pass quadrant tiling demands dedicated GPU acceleration (~7–18s per broadsheet, ~1s per monograph).
📜 Microfilm & Degraded Ink (Heritage: 58.3% QA Win, +37.7% Words): Adaptive CLAHE contrast enhancement and deep DBNet line detection enable Paddle to recover faint census ink, bleed-through text, and marginal notations missed by ABBYY's rigid binarization—yielding 35,076 valid word wins vs 25,056 (58.3%) and surfacing +298,724 extra searchable words across Heritage microfilm reels.
📰 Newspaper Layout & Arbitration (81.7% Win Rate): On high-density multi-column broadsheets, 3×2 quadrant tiling and reading-order arbitration eliminate column-bleed and preserve natural reading flow. Paddle decisively outperforms ABBYY in lexical disputes (4,663 vs 1,041 wins, 81.7%), cleanly resolving tight classified advertisements.
⚠️ GPU Footprint & Tiling Latency (~7–18s Broadsheet, ~1.0s Monograph): Unlike CPU-native engines (e.g. Indra), Paddle requires dedicated CUDA hardware and substantial VRAM (~2–4 GB per worker). With our staged batch-32 pipeline, standard monograph pages process in ~0.9–1.2s, while dense 24MP newspaper broadsheets undergoing 3×2 quadrant tiling (6 sub-tiles + full pass) complete in ~7–18s per page (down from unbatched ~25–70s). While 3–4x faster, multi-pass tiling remains a compute-intensive workload compared to single-pass processing.
⚖️ High Recall vs. Marginal Noise (+26.8% Word Expansion): Aggressive sensitivity surfaces +338,622 extra words archive-wide, capturing library penciling, accession stamps, and damaged border strokes that ABBYY disregarded. While maximizing discovery, it also generates non-lexical fragments in degraded margins, necessitating post-OCR dictionary filtering to eliminate false positives.

Page Explorer & Interactive Review (4154 Pages)
Page / Item Name ⓘ Page / Item Name
Unique digital archive page stem. Click "Open Viewer →" in the Action column to inspect bounding boxes and side-by-side diffs.
 ▲ 		Collection ⓘ Collection
Publication category or archive sub-collection (e.g. Newspapers, Annuals, Heritage Microfilms). Filterable via dropdown.
 ⇕ 		Words: P / B (Delta) ⓘ Total Words & Delta
P = Pipeline (Paddle) words, B = Benchmark (ABBYY) words, and (Delta) = P − B.
• Positive (+): Paddle extracted more words (higher recall in fine print/captions).
• Negative (−): ABBYY extracted more words.
Click column header to sort by lowest delta (Paddle fewer) or highest.
⇕ 		Spatial Align ⓘ Spatial Alignment (Box Overlap)
Measures whether Paddle and ABBYY detected words in the same physical coordinate positions on the page, regardless of character recognition.
Spatial vs Concordance:
• Spatial Alignment tests WHERE words are located (box overlap IoU ≥ 0.25).
• Concordance tests WHAT the text characters say.
Both can find a box at the exact same coordinates (100% spatial align) even if they read different words.
⇕ 		Concordance ⓘ Clean Text Concordance
Character-level agreement between Paddle and ABBYY for spatially matched words (normalized for punctuation and case).
• ≥ 90% (Green): High consensus; both engines agree.
• 80% – 90% (Yellow): Moderate agreement.
• < 80% (Red): Divergence; manual review suggested.
Key Point: Tests text character correctness rather than box coordinates.
⇕ 		Paddle QA Win ⓘ Paddle QA Win Rate
Automated dictionary validation on disputed words. Tests candidate words against English and French lexicons.
• Paddle Win: Paddle produced a valid real word while ABBYY produced OCR noise.
• ABBYY Win: ABBYY produced a valid real word while Paddle failed.
Win Rate = Paddle Wins ÷ (Paddle Wins + ABBYY Wins).
⇕ 		Diffs ⓘ Discrepancy Count
Total number of word boxes where Paddle and ABBYY disagree on the text characters.
Pages with high diff counts usually have degraded historical print or tight newspaper columns that benefit from side-by-side inspection.
⇕ 		Action ⓘ Interactive Viewer
Opens the synchronized interactive side-by-side zoomable visual viewer for in-depth inspection and manual adjudication.
